environment.cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 Pro 7735U with Radeon Graphics
environment.biasNotes: Linux/ext4 only, per the 2026-07-26 scope narrowing. Development machine; latency and startup thresholds remain hypotheses until a real-hardware pass (A2).

method: Two owned isolated Linux launches; real panel batch accept and per-document undo, checked against SQLite and readable mirror bytes. Screenshot before undo. No working-memory or performance measurement.

verdicts.threshold: both outside bodies committed before undo
selected document returns to its exact preaccept body at the next revision
every other document keeps its postaccept body and revision
accepted words remain in durable document history
normal outbound pass writes the exact original readable document
